rationale.text: A visible iframe has no title attribute and no aria-hidden. The test asks each frame for a title attribute; the only way out in the official text is the glossary's note on technical frames made unavailable to assistive technologies with aria-hidden="true", which this frame does not use. The custom check faults it (step 5) through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) a-t-il un attribut `title`

Si cela ne gêne pas le fonctionnement de ce type de cadre, il est possible de les rendre indisponibles aux technologies d’assistance en utilisant l’attribut WAI-ARIA aria-hidden="true". Dans ce cas le critère 2.1 et le critère 2.2 seront non applicables.
